description: Atlas Battery Limited manufactures and sells automotive, motorcycle and energy-storage batteries and allied products under the AGS brand, a name drawn from Atlas and Genzo Shimadzu, founder of Japan Storage Battery. Incorporated in 1966 and part of the Atlas Group, it has held a technical collaboration with Japan Storage Battery — now GS Yuasa Corporation — since 1969, and its range runs from conventional batteries to low-maintenance hybrid, maintenance-free and deep-cycle types for vehicles, gensets, UPS equipment and solar systems.
